title: Salt Orris split at the waterline

tokens.v: The flacon stands on a pale stone block in still water, the one water surface crossing the glass just below its label, so the label and the black cap stand in the calm air above while the lower third of the bottle sits in the water, slightly magnified, olive caustics rippling over it and over the stone. The lens sits exactly at the water surface, 90mm, the meniscus climbing the glass where the surface meets it and a few fine bubbles clinging below the line.
